steps.description_modal:
About this space
Situated just footsteps from both Coconuts and Plantation surf breaks is Coconut Surf Inn guesthouse. This undiscovered gem is a peaceful, serene oasis that is tucked away from the busy Galle - Matara road, but it right next to the beach.
The space
Coconut Surf Inn is the Eranga family home, so staying here means you will experience the endless warm smiles and kind hospitality of the gracious host Chintaka and his family.
Next to the guesthouse is a large open grassed area overlooking the beach, where the friendly locals and tourists alike gather to watch the surf, play cricket, socialise and enjoy beautiful sunrises and sunsets. You can truly immerse yourself in the life of a small Sri Lankan village.
Coconuts is a consistent A-frame reef break, located in front of the guesthouse. Plantations is a more mellow wave, located just 100 meters walk up the beach. This really is a surfer's paradise.
This isn't just a place to stay, it's a place to live. Enjoy beautiful Midigama from this charming guesthouse right by the beach.
Guest access
There are 09 rooms, with each having a double bed, ceiling fan , Wall fan and own bathroom. Sheets and towels are provided. Hammocks, a shady restaurant area and garden, outdoor shower, clothes line and surf board rack are all provided. All meals, snacks and drinks available.(Break fast not included to the Price)
